imagery.method: Reviewed independent zoom-19 Esri World Imagery captures for 15 eligible Fire/EMS records at average scale 0.215 m/pixel. For fitted sites, the individually sized rectangle follows the visible building, immediate parking/apron and observable access aisle; dimensions and rotation remain estimates. Sites with a conflicting/stale capture are left without a fit.

roads.assessment: Packaged road/service geometry was reviewed with imagery. Runtime QA follows an actual response route through fitted-yard boundaries; mapped graph segments do not verify driveway rights or apparatus doors.

limits: Most fits use imagery estimates; EMS27 additionally uses the official York building footprint and official YorkMaps address point for facility identity.
Dimensions, centers, rotations and modeled spawn coordinates are imagery/road-geometry estimates, not surveyed measurements.
Imagery does not verify apparatus bays, gates, access controls, current pavement, occupancy or driveway rights.
Canonical IDs and source coordinates remain unchanged.

Collision QA follows a real route from modeled spawn until at least 10 m outside the expanded fitted yard and checks movement in 1.5 m increments; this verifies the modeled collision transition, not sustained manual driving or real-world response suitability.
Shared Fire/EMS fits represent exact co-located site records and do not establish EMS-only bays or entrances.
